# Earthen Phoenix

> Massage, bodywork, Reiki, private yoga, astrology, tarot and herbal remedies with Miquelle in Salt Lake City, Utah. "Ground your soul."

- Phone / text: 801-609-4263
- Email: info@earthenphoenix.com
- Booking: https://earthenphoenix.com/appointment-8682
- First-time clients: 20% off the first service
- Miquelle: Reiki since 2011 (Master Reiki practitioner); Utah College of Massage Therapy 2012.

## Sessions

- [Swedish massage](https://earthenphoenix.com/swedish-massage.html): $140 / $170, 60 / 90 min. Long strokes and essential oils, light to medium pressure.
- [Deep tissue massage](https://earthenphoenix.com/deep-tissue-massage.html): $150 / $180, 60 / 90 min. Deep pressure, breathwork and stretching. Never painful.
- [Thai bodywork](https://earthenphoenix.com/thai-bodywork.html): $150 / $170, 60 / 90 min. Full-body stretching and rhythmic compressions.
- [Lymphatic firming body treatment](https://earthenphoenix.com/lymphatic-firming-treatment.html): $180, 90 min. Dry brushing, lymphatic massage, a heated wrap.
- [Sarga bodywork](https://earthenphoenix.com/sarga-bodywork.html): $180, 90 min. Barefoot, with a fabric strap, for old injuries.
- [Reiki](https://earthenphoenix.com/reiki.html): $130, 60 min. Hands on or near the clothed body.
- [Zen mountain session](https://earthenphoenix.com/zen-mountain-session.html): $200, 90 min. A private massage beside a mountain river.
- [Private yoga](https://earthenphoenix.com/private-yoga.html): $140, 60 min. Vinyasa flow, then slow Yin holds.
- [Astrology & tarot](https://earthenphoenix.com/astrology-tarot.html): $2 / min, by the minute. Birth-chart, tarot and oracle readings.
- [Herbalism consultation](https://earthenphoenix.com/herbalism.html): about $40–$100, varies. Custom teas, rollies and tinctures.
